headline: President Biden cancels part of an earlier executive order, Executive Order 13961, while leaving the rest in place.
what_it_does: This order takes back, or revokes, some parts of Executive Order 13961, an earlier presidential order. The title does not say which parts are canceled or why. Any parts not revoked stay in effect.

who_it_affects.how: Agencies that were following the canceled parts of Executive Order 13961 would likely no longer need to follow those directions, though the title does not say which agencies or rules are involved.

when_it_takes_effect: Not stated in the title. Executive orders usually take effect when signed, which here was January 19, 2025.
